dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Berri arrived at MACC following a bite incident in the home. Berri's previous owner stated that he will snap and bite whenever someone touches his collar or attempts to remove it. They also state that he does not allow nail trims and will growl and attempt to bite. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Berri
